Controls.Title: Controls & Gestures
Controls.Invitation: Get to know the mobile controls
Controls.MenuHint: Help with tabs and controls for your game.

Entries.CharacterTab: Character: View your character, make rolls, and manage resources. Use the tabs below the character header to find what you need.
Entries.ChatTab: Chat: Read rolls and messages, send a message, or type a dice roll.
Entries.JournalsTab: Journals: Browse the journals shared with you and open their pages.
Entries.InitiativeTab: Initiative: See turn order and whose turn it is. Use **End Turn** when your turn is finished. Expand **Targets** to select or deselect combatants.
Entries.SettingsTab: Settings: Change the layout, colors, sound, and other preferences for this browser. You can reopen this guide here.
Entries.WarhammerMain: Main: Roll characteristics, track Wounds and other resources, and check your XP. The bed beside Wounds starts a recovery test; apply healing from the result in Chat.
Entries.WarhammerCombat: Combat: Select Targets, roll weapon attacks, and check movement and encumbrance.
Entries.WarhammerCombat4e: Combat: Select Targets, roll weapon attacks, and track Advantage. Movement and encumbrance are also shown here.
Entries.WarhammerCombat5e: Combat: Select Targets, roll weapon attacks, and check Momentum, movement, and encumbrance.
Entries.WarhammerSkills: Skills: Find basic and advanced skills. Tap a skill with a dice icon to make a test.
Entries.WarhammerTrappings: Trappings: Check your equipment, money, encumbrance, and Social Status.
Entries.WarhammerTalents: Talents: Read your talents and traits. Expand **Details** to read a description.
Entries.WarhammerMagic: Magic: Tap a spell with a dice icon to cast it. Tap an available Wind to channel it.
Entries.WarhammerEffects: Effects: Track conditions and read injuries and other effects. Choose a condition to show its row, then use its toggle or minus/plus buttons to change it. Buttons beside active conditions run their listed actions.
Entries.WarhammerNotes: Notes: Read and edit your character notes and ambitions. Save your changes before leaving the editor.
Entries.ShadowdarkAbilities: Abilities: Roll ability checks and weapon attacks, track HP and other counters, and select Targets.
Entries.ShadowdarkSpells: Spells: Cast known spells and check which spells are lost.
Entries.ShadowdarkInventory: Inventory: Check gear slots, carried and stashed gear, and coins. Use **Add** to choose catalog gear or create an item. Changing an item's quantity to zero removes it.
Entries.ShadowdarkTalents: Talents: Read your ancestry, class, and level talents. Expand **Details** to read more.
Entries.Notes: Notes: Read and edit your character notes. Save your changes before leaving the editor.
Entries.DndFavourites: Favourites (when enabled): Find the items, spells, and features you have marked as favourites.
Entries.DndOverview: Overview: Check HP, defenses, and resources, and select Targets. Open Abilities for checks and saves, or Effects for conditions and other effects.
Entries.DndInventory: Inventory: Browse equipment and currency. Tap an item to read its details; hold it for actions.
Entries.DndSpells: Spells: Find spells and check spell slots. Tap a spell for details; hold it for casting and other actions.
Entries.DndFeatures: Features: Browse class features and other abilities. Tap for details; hold for actions.
Entries.DndBiography: Biography: Read your character's background and personal details.
Entries.GroupMembers: Members: View the group roster. Tap a member to open their character.
Entries.GroupSupplies: Supplies: Check the group's shared equipment and currency.
Entries.VehicleStatus: Status: Check the vehicle's condition, defenses, and movement.
Entries.VehicleActions: Actions: Find the vehicle's weapons and other actions.
Entries.VehicleCargo: Cargo: Browse the vehicle's equipment and supplies.
Entries.VehicleDetails: Details: Check dimensions, carrying capacity, crew, and passengers, and read the vehicle's description.
Entries.Portrait: Tap the **portrait** to view its image.
Entries.Chooser: Tap the **character name** to choose another character.
Entries.NativeChooser: Tap the **arrow beside the portrait** to choose another character. Open folders to browse their characters.
Entries.NativeSheet: **Open Foundry Sheet** opens the full character sheet for more options.
Entries.Rows: Tap an item, spell, or feature for details. **Hold a row** to open its action menu, then choose the action you want.
Entries.Members: Back returns from a member to the group.
Entries.Counters: Tap the **padlock** to unlock a counter. **Minus and plus** change it immediately. Tap its number to enter a value, then **Save**.
Entries.Descriptions: Tap **Details** to show or hide a description.
Entries.ItemNotes: Tap **Notes** on an item to read the full note. Tap outside the text to close it.
Entries.ConditionReferences: Tap a condition name to read its rules. Tap it again or tap outside to close the text.
Entries.Back: **Back** or **Escape** closes the open menu, dialog, or detail view.
Entries.DesktopReview: To use the mobile layout in this browser, choose Phone or Tablet under **Mobile Mode** in Foundry settings.
Entries.Phone: Use the bottom navigation to switch main tabs.
Entries.Tablet: Use the side navigation to switch main tabs. Its arrow button moves it to the other side.
